Yes, this feels natural and the chips are genuinely useful. Being able to put more than one label on a bookmark matters — a link often belongs to a couple of different groups in my head. Clicking "+ Research" to add it, seeing my existing labels offered so I can just pick them, and being able to type a brand-new name to create one — that all works the way I'd expect. And seeing the labels sitting right on the card as those little chips is exactly what makes a link recognizable at a glance. I like it.

One small thing I'd want as I build up more labels: when I start typing a new one, I'd like it to show me the existing labels that match what I'm typing, so I can pick the one I already have instead of accidentally creating a slightly-different duplicate — like ending up with both "Research" and "research" or "researching." As long as it nudges me toward my existing labels as I type, this is just right.

Show me the other approach when you're ready.
